scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof with a finite standard-library numerical checker; no infinite numerical certification or independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the explicit cubic volume-preserving parameter slice and invariant finite-volume lobe. Invariant tori, first integral, and general period/resonance ideas are prior literature; the proposed quantitative finding is the sharp physical-volume winding tail. The full directly relevant 2023 Zhong–Liang paper could not be inspected and publication priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp invariant-volume resonance tail in a cubic Hopf–Langford flow
